dogecoin.text: Stood up my first ever #clojure application on the web today to manage a swarm of #dogecoin miners.  Lots of leveling up this break

I feel very “conscious” every time I throw away a glass bottle.  Then I remember that glass is just melted sand and the energy to melt the sand is less than it takes to mine a dogecoin transaction and I remember the world is really weird and amazing.
